info.title: Herdr Mobile Relay REST API
info.description: Lean Herdr HTTP API and optional terminal WebSocket. No bundled UI, browser push, or ACP endpoint.

TailscaleServeIdentity.name: Tailscale-User-Login
TailscaleServeIdentity.description: Injected by Tailscale Serve for remote traffic. Do not manufacture this header; configure `HERDR_RELAY_TRUSTED_USER` on the relay.

NativeMutation.name: X-Herdr-Client
NativeMutation.description: Set to `herdr-mobile-v1` only for a native non-browser mutation without an Origin header. Browser requests use same-origin protection instead.
